## Motivation

What problem does this solve? Describe the workload, use case, or
integration that would benefit.

## Proposed API or behavior

Sketch the C API, on-disk format change, or configuration surface
you have in mind. Reference existing types where relevant.

## Alternatives considered

Other designs you rejected and why. If the goal can be met with the
current API, say so.

## Compatibility

Would this break the v1 C ABI, the on-disk file format, or the
`docs/PAGER_INVARIANTS.md` invariants? If yes, sketch a migration
path.
